data_fields.name: depreciationPerUnitHeld
data_fields.donor_constant: per-shop value from STO record (percentage points per unit already in stock)

data_fields.name: jewelryDepreciates
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: GEM, RING, AMULET count as 0 held

data_fields.name: charismaPctTerm
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: ability-table bonus added to sell-side percent (table values not read)

data_fields.name: reputationScalePct
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: sell-side percent multiplied by repmodst table value over 100 (table values not read)

best_idea: One pure price function driven by per-shop data (markup, depreciation, flags) and the buyer's modifiers, that the server uses to quote and settle, with gold moved only after the item move succeeds.
decision_why: Shape fits a shop in a zone (markup and depreciation as shop data, one quote function, pay on success); the donor's client-side gold moves and its second engine price path violate one-ledger, server-verified.
acceptance: Server test: a 50 gp item sold by a shop with SellMarkup 120 and no modifiers quotes 60 and debits exactly 60 on the server ledger; a sale whose item move fails credits 0; the client shop label equals the server quote for the same inputs.
